scope: A controlled compiler-key-order correction and truthful metadata rename. Synthetic native grammar tests and iOS package compilation only; no model generation, rendering or phone operation.

implementationDelta.compilerPropertyOrder: Within each schema object, serialize properties in required[] listed order first, followed by sorted optional keys. Preserve required[] arrays and all schema values/types.
implementationDelta.traversal: Recurse only through schema-bearing keyword positions. const/enum/default/examples and annotation objects remain literal JSON even when they contain type/properties/required keys.
implementationDelta.variantRequiredFields: Primitive geometry and selected origin/attach fields also occur in their authoritative required[] positions before optional fields.
implementationDelta.numericCompatibility: Unchanged: only type:number minimum/maximum/exclusiveMinimum/exclusiveMaximum are deferred at compile boundary; Core must strictly validate decoded numeric bounds.

metadataRename.reason: Completion precedes Core validation and Direct callers may never validate; the field states a requirement, not an already-performed check.

implementationDelta.identity: originalSchemaSHA256 hashes the original supplied schema. compiledSchemaSHA256 hashes the actual required-first serialized compiler input, including the unchanged numeric compatibility conversion.

iOSPackageCompile.command: swift build --package-path Apple/Packages/QwenNative -c release --disable-automatic-resolution --triple arm64-apple-ios26.0 --sdk /Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer/Platforms/iPhoneOS.platform/Developer/SDKs/iPhoneOS27.2.sdk --target QwenNative

testedEvidence: Actual native matcher accepts id then primitive then dimensions containing width,height,depth then color.
Actual native matcher rejects depth,height,width order and canonical sorted-key JSON when their keys do not match compiler order; arbitrary JSON key order is explicitly not claimed.

Test fixtures alone are explicitly reordered before matcher input. ScenePlan decoded values equal untouched original snapshots, including full node/freeform budgets, Float boundaries, long decimals, scientific notation, attachments and Unicode names.
Nested schema serialization changes order without changing parsed schema values/types. Literal objects containing properties/required/type:number are neither interpreted nor float-normalized.
Integer bounds, cardinalities, malformed quote and unknown-property rejection tests still pass; native Core continues rejecting deferred invalid float ranges.
Existing failure closure, clone/replay isolation, EOS lookahead, padding, public producer cancellation/length and 30-cycle weak-owner lifetime tests still pass.

completionBoundary.observedByCodeReview: onCompletion covers completed producer handling and explicit grammar failures. Tokenizer/input preparation errors or cancellation before producer creation (including chunked prefill) may throw without invoking onCompletion.
completionBoundary.cleanup: The stream synchronization defer remains active on pre-producer exits.
completionBoundary.counts: Do not infer zero counts or absence of cancellation from a missing callback. No unknown counts are fabricated.
completionBoundary.testCoverage: The cancellation test exercises an existing public producer, not pre-producer cancellation.

notEstablished: That field order was the sole cause of the previous poor chair geometry
That this key-order change improves model output or visual quality
Full-model grammar generation performance or memory
App build/test or real-device behavior by this agent
A complete plan fitting the unchanged token budget
interpretation: This is a discriminating field-order probe. Earlier guided id-first experiments also had poor geometry; syntax/order tests are not quality acceptance. Parent-owned before/after model runs and original bad output remain separate evidence.
sanitization: Source hashes, fixed synthetic test names/counts/timings and documented limitations only. No prompts, model responses, user content, credentials or device identifiers. Ignored logs remain outside Git.
